title: Change the agent's instructions mid-call
summary: A tool result replaces the system prompt on the call in progress, summarising or dropping the earlier turns, with no transfer.
scenario: A front desk that becomes billing or the workshop once it knows why you called

evidence: sdk function_result.py:699-725 switch_context emits the key context_switch; object form when consolidate/full_reset/user_prompt set, bare string otherwise
schema.json ContextSwitchAction documents context_switch as an object (system_prompt, user_prompt, consolidate, full_reset)
